mapper.sql: id, user_a_id, user_b_id, last_message, last_time, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chat_session WHERE user_a_id = #{userAId} AND user_b_id = #{userBId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_session SET last_message = #{lastMessage}, last_time = #{lastTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS sessionId, u.id AS peerId, u.nickname AS peerNickname, u.avatar AS peerAvatar, s.last_message AS lastMessage, s.last_time AS lastTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message m WHERE m.session_id = s.id AND m.to_user_id = #{userId} AND m.is_read = 0 AND m.deleted = 0) AS unreadCount FROM chat_session s JOIN `user` u ON u.id = (CASE WHEN s.user_a_id = #{userId} THEN s.user_b_id ELSE s.user_a_id END) AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE (s.user_a_id = #{userId} OR s.user_b_id = #{userId}) AND s.deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.last_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_session s WHERE (s.user_a_id = #{userId} OR s.user_b_id = #{userId}) AND s.deleted = 0
